C-REQUIRED-EVIDENCE-GATE.IntentSummary: Approval-ready implementation proposal; status remains draft pending user approval. Current authorization covers plan refinement and isolated existing-runner probes only. Future command interfaces and hard acceptance budgets are specified below; they are not measured implementation performance. Repository tooling delivery and remote protection activation are distinct milestones. No implementation task or GitHub setting change has executed.

T-001.Title: Define scenario obligations, canonical evidence schema, input fingerprint and trust bootstrap

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Specify collected test identity, required profiles/layers, permitted mock boundaries, producer provenance and artifact digests. Freeze input paths/modes/content and exact closure normalization; do not rely on authored passed flags. Store generated evidence in ignored .verification-results/C-ID; absence of that directory blocks the final checker.

Implement the declared interface: python3 tools/verification/gate.py run --change C-ID --evidence-dir DIRECTORY collects and executes approved obligations; check with the same arguments verifies existing evidence without starting services. Independent pytest contract tests invoke the checker as a subprocess and verify exit and reason codes, rather than trusting its own self-test declaration.

Use explicit proposed acceptance caps: run is an acceptance-stage command with 900-second limit for the narrow pilot; contract pytest leaf 120 seconds; evidence check leaf 30 seconds. Existing Full Verification Gate retains its separate 60-minute workflow cap. Measure actual new-tool timings after implementation; exceedance fails and requires optimization or reviewed plan revision, never silent timeout increase. No claim that unimplemented command timings were measured.

Trust bootstrap is a separately owner-reviewed checker/policy revision on the protected base. CI aggregator runs that revision in a separate job without executing candidate source, parses only bounded declarative reports, checks run/candidate/base identities and hashes, and verifies obligations from base plus independently approved additions. Candidate tests run without privileged credentials. No candidate artifact may become executable input to the trusted job.

Verification.Command: Review schema and trust-boundary examples against every spec NegativeScenarios anchor; no GitHub mutation. Planning probes on 2026-11-09: Vitest collection 5.028s exit0, empty selector 1.626s exit1, Playwright collection 2.529s exit0 in disposable frontend copy. These do not test the future gate.

T-002.Title: Implement isolated execution adapters and evidence collection

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Use existing pytest, Vitest and Playwright. Validate collection, actual outcomes, profiles, exit statuses and redacted artifacts; detect before/after content drift. CI uses fresh candidate runs, never imports local self-authored evidence as authoritative.
Keep application tests and code read-only in this tooling change. Fixtures may simulate runner outputs; real negative witness executes only in disposable copies.

Verification.Command: Run scoped isolated positive/negative producer fixtures; inspect artifacts for secret leakage and verify no real checkout .env or external provider access.

T-003.Title: Implement fail-closed checker and complete adversarial suite

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Cover N-MISSING-REPORT, N-ZERO-TESTS, N-SKIP-XFAIL, N-OLD-SNAPSHOT, N-INPUT-CHANGE, N-WRONG-LAYER, N-PROFILE-GAP, N-TAMPER and P-COMPLETE-EVIDENCE. Rejection returns nonzero with specific reasons; no warn-only mode or fallback to aggregate green counts.
All mandatory cases are rejected for missing evidence even when unrelated tests pass. A test that expects gate rejection is distinguished from the failed product scenario.

Verification.Command: Compare generated artifacts and verdicts with independent fixture expectations, including controlled failure-then-pass retries and concurrent edits.

T-004.Title: Integrate leaf gate and lifecycle comparison with GRACE

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Register current policy/evidence navigation and instructions without duplicating product authority. MustPassCommand checks evidence only; outer selected final lint remains controller-owned. Reject N-LIFECYCLE-BYPASS and N-CLOSURE-NORMALIZATION against base bundle inventory, including removed bundles and removed assertions.
Do not rewrite old archives or repin CLI. Local enforcement limits and the distinction between repository implementation and remote activation remain explicit.

Verification.Command: In disposable GRACE fixtures, execute selected target/final lint with run-commands and test approved-to-applied/archive transitions plus tampered XML. No recursive GRACE command inside MustPassCommand.

T-005.Title: Prepare independent CI producers and unconditional acceptance aggregation

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Preserve Full Verification Gate and add uniquely named Required Evidence Gate. Explicitly reject every mandatory dependency outcome other than success and missing/corrupt artifacts. Require fresh candidate/base identity and protected-base policy; N-CI-INCOMPLETE and N-POLICY-WEAKENING have rejection coverage.

Use least-privilege execution for candidate code; never privileged pull_request_target execution of untrusted code. Workflow/config protection and approved owner review are activation prerequisites, not claimed settings.

Verification.Command: Simulate producer success/failure/skip/cancel/timeout/missing report, old SHA and candidate workflow/policy deletion. Inspect workflow events and dependency aggregation; do not push or alter GitHub settings.

T-006.Title: Run isolated acceptance pilot and document remaining activation blockers

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All rejection families plus positive controls pass on the exact tooling snapshot. Reproduce N-UI-IN-DELIVERY using the real built admin SPA with synthetic APIs; four profiles must block the product obligation despite green existing frontend tests. Do not fix or exempt the defect.

Record actual commands, runtime budgets, snapshot and limitations. Existing applicable LDD remains mandatory; synthetic UI proof cannot substitute for backend/LDD. Independently review final checker bypass resistance and evidence identity before authorized implementation closure.

Verification.Command: After implementation authorization, run isolated browser witness and inspect traces/screenshots plus verifier rejection; use controlled passing fixtures for acceptance controls.
Externally run pinned verify-pin, selected final lint with run-commands and status. Preserve Git/source scope and retain evidence outside tracked sources.
